npcs.name: Old guy neighbour
npcs.text: Oh hello there - good day! Have you just recently moved in next door? Everyone in this town loves playing the Pokemon Card game. I recommend visiting the Celeste Harbour Lighthouse South West of here and introducing yourself, everyone in this neighbourhood is super friendly.
npcs.repeat_text: Oh don't mind me, I'm just tidying up here, the sea breeze can blow bits of rubbish from the sea so I like to keep the place tidy, I'd go check out the Lighthouse while it's still daylight!

npcs.name: Old lady on bench
npcs.text: Hello! Sadly I can't play the Pokemon card game as I'm not very good, but my grandson says 'Weaknesses' and 'Resistances' are key.
npcs.repeat_text: If you always pay attention to a Pokemon's Weaknesses and Resistances then you'll always have a good chance of winning I believe.

npcs.name: Policeman blocking beach BL
npcs.text: We've currently got a large migration of Sharpedo passing through the harbour so it's not safe for anyone to be on the beach at the moment, it's going to be shut for a short while.
npcs.repeat_text: We'll reopen the beach once all of the Sharpedo have passed through. They migrate this way once a year but they tend to go through pretty quick.

npcs.name: Policeman blocking beach M
npcs.text: We've currently got a large migration of Sharpedo passing through the harbour so it's not safe for anyone to be on the beach at the moment, it's going to be shut for a short while.
npcs.repeat_text: We'll reopen the beach once all of the Sharpedo have passed through. They migrate this way once a year but they tend to go through pretty quick.

npcs.name: Policeman blocking beach R
npcs.text: We've currently got a large migration of Sharpedo passing through the harbour so it's not safe for anyone to be on the beach at the moment, it's going to be shut for a short while.
npcs.repeat_text: We'll reopen the beach once all of the Sharpedo have passed through. They migrate this way once a year but they tend to go through pretty quick.

npcs.name: Maintenance guy watering sunflowers
npcs.text: Sorry, I can't battle right now, my boss will get mad if I do while I'm on the clock. I've gotta water all of these flowers and it's gonna take me ages.
npcs.repeat_text: I should be finished with this shortly and will accept a battle as soon as I'm done, come find me again this evening when I've finished.

npcs.name: Maintenance guy fixing the lighthouse
npcs.text: I'm just about to replace the lighthouse bulb with a new one. It's a loooooonnnnng way to the top, probably about 10,000 steps! I'm getting too old to be doing this but it's an important job
npcs.repeat_text: Weellll... it's not really 10,000 steps but it feels like that many. Can't let the lightbulb get worn out - If it does it'll mean a lot of trouble for the harbour so the responsibility is larger than the climb up!

npcs.name: Maintenance guy blocking forest
npcs.text: Sorry, the forest is closed off while we do some essential maintenance. We had even more wind than usual last night resulting in a lot of falling branches causing a safety hazard.
npcs.repeat_text: Sorry but it's going to take a least a day or maybe two. Once we've cleared all the loose branches and removed the fallen trees it'll be safe for people to enter again.

npcs.name: Gift_Lady_Rose
npcs.text: Here, take this card! I have far too many duplicates.
npcs.post_gift_text: I just keep finding duplicates everywhere I look!

npcs.name: Coin_Collector_Pete
npcs.text: I found this coin on the harbour floor, you take it.
npcs.post_gift_text: I always seem to find coins wherever I walk. Maybe I should check the floor more often!

npcs.name: Generous_Gerald
npcs.text: My uncle gave me some spending money, here take some!
npcs.post_gift_text: My uncle is always really generous, I think it runs in the family!

opponents.name: Lass_Jennifer
opponents.meet_text: I just got given some cards off my grandma, I'm not really good at battling but it's fun!
opponents.rematch_text: I could definitely use some more practice
opponents.first_win_text: I'll get better at this one day
opponents.rematch_win_text: I might never be great but at least I'm having a good time
opponents.loss_text: I didn't expect to win at all!

opponents.name: Gambler_Mick
opponents.meet_text: I let luck decide my fate, if I battle enough then I'll win some of them at least
opponents.rematch_text: I'll be a lot luckier this time
opponents.first_win_text: Luck wasn't on my side today...
opponents.rematch_win_text: All it'll take is a bit of luck and I'll win
opponents.loss_text: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today

opponents.name: Schoolboy_Adam
opponents.meet_text: I'm trying out some new techniques using statuses. If we battle I'll show you how good they are
opponents.rematch_text: I'll definitely win this time round
opponents.first_win_text: Oh man I really thought my statuses were going to cause you some trouble
opponents.rematch_win_text: Maybe I need a better tactic...
opponents.loss_text: I knew my status infliction technique would work!

opponents.name: Fisherman_Dave
opponents.meet_text: I love the lighthouse, it seems to attract all kinds of fish so I always catch a lot here. I'm catching so much I need a break
opponents.rematch_text: Wanna see what I've caught since last time?
opponents.first_win_text: Even if they don't help me win, I still love my fish
opponents.rematch_win_text: Fishing is just good for the soul
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should try picking up a rod and give fishing a go instead!

opponents.name: Fisherman_John
opponents.meet_text: Hey there, I'm trying to catch the biggest fish in these waters but nothing seems to be biting. Want to help me check my bait with a battle?
opponents.rematch_text: Oh hey again, I don't mind another battle
opponents.first_win_text: I should have been paying more attention to my fishing...
opponents.rematch_win_text: Always happy to put my fishing aside for another one!
opponents.loss_text: I'm not just the best round here at fishing!

opponents.name: Bug_Catcher_Alex
opponents.meet_text: Some people hate bugs but I love them! Want me to show you what I've caught?
opponents.rematch_text: You just love bugs as much as I do then?
opponents.first_win_text: Maybe bugs aren't as good as I thought...
opponents.rematch_win_text: Me and my bugs will win one of these days!
opponents.loss_text: I knew bugs were the best!!

opponents.name: Swimmer_Jordan
opponents.meet_text: I love the water, it's so calm and warm but my cards always get wet! Help me dry them off?
opponents.rematch_text: I can always take a break for another match
opponents.rematch_win_text: Nothing like a good match and a long swim
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should work on your swimming...
